description: Entrance, exit and loop presets layered over the clip transform (video://catalog/animations): e.g. in {name: "pop", duration_frames: 12}, loop {name: "float"}; a loop runs the whole clip, or only from_frame to to_frame of it (loop {name: "shake", from_frame: 30, to_frame: 45} for a jolt). null removes one. Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

from_frame.description: Frame from the clip start where it begins, its first repeat starting there; like keyframes it stays on that moment of the source through trims and splits. Default the clip start

to_frame.description: Frame from the clip start it stops before, back at rest. Default the clip end

loop.description: Repeats over the clip, or over from_frame to to_frame of it

out.description: Exit, ending at the clip end

preview.description: inline: image in the result; link: URI that renders on read; none

timeline_id.description: Timeline handle; every edit returns a new one

name: clip.set_animation

parent.description: Timeline handle; every edit returns a new one

placements.description: Where each clip the edit moved, cropped, masked or animated shows, sequence pixels

complete.description: true: values move in straight lines between entries; false: evenly sampled

picture.description: The whole picture, before crop and mask and rotation

source.description: The part of the source that shows, source pixels

visible.description: What it shows: crop and mask applied, rotated, inside the frame; null: nothing

frames.description: Frames shown; for a waveform, the start and end of its span

loudness.description: Measured for audio edits, over the waveform span

timeline_id.description: Timeline handle; every edit returns a new one

title: Set animation
